package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for response_envelope_shaping_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated success-response envelope formatting that should live in a renderer or transport helper.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Order struct {
	ID     int    `json:"id"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
}

type Customer struct {
	ID   int    `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func GetOrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	order := Order{ID: 1, Status: "shipped"}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"data":     order,
		"meta":     map[string]any{"timestamp": time.Now().Unix()},
		"success":  true,
	})
}

func GetCustomerHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	customer := Customer{ID: 42, Name: "Acme Corp"}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"data":     customer,
		"meta":     map[string]any{"timestamp": time.Now().Unix()},
		"success":  true,
	})
}
